verdict.rationale: Docusign ships official SDKs (e.g., Node.js eSign client) and publishes OpenAPI/Swagger specs used to generate these client libraries, plus a full REST API reference, giving AI-native developers concrete building blocks. However, community hands-on reports are mixed — some engineers call the API workable ('API is fine... implementation really isn't hard') while others call the documentation 'garbage' and report confusion implementing use-cases, suggesting real friction beyond just existence of SDKs. Missing for 10: broader language-SDK coverage evidence (only Node.js client cited), and no independent confirmation that AI-native/agentic workflows specifically build smoothly against these SDKs.
